messages.author: Ticklepuss
messages.text:
**__Blubber Magazine - 2013 Brule Round 1 Preview - Take It Up With Cocksinsun Volume 127__**

“We did it yinz!”, exclaimed an anonymous source said after last Friday’s regular season final box scores trickled in.  Some spent a few hours patting themselves on the back for managing to complete 56 games in 90 days, while others moved on to other stuff to complain about.  Now that the playoffs have arrived at last, the rule tinkering and complaining should subside for 2-3 weeks….

Round 1 has some juicy matchups….Yeah, seems that way every season, but a few really do stand out for the S18 version of the Brule Playoffs.


__(1) Sumter vs (16) Autobahn__
Team Autobahn finally makes it back to the dance after an incredibly long hiatus and draws a team trying to get to their 5th Finals in a row.  Welcome back!

What to Expect:  
BellNBell podcast guest Jim Elephants laughed out loud when asked if Sumter would win this series, then provided, what some have called, a snarky “yeah”.  If you’ve read his books on success, confidence doesn’t seem to be an issue in the Sumter locker room.   Coming off a regular season that saw them lose just 8 games in regulation, it’s very difficult to see the Trash losing to a team that hasn’t finished in the top 16 for the better part of a decade.  Stranger things have happened….Have they though?  Returning to the Brule marks a milestone for Team Autobahn, and NHL95 fans across the globe hope to continue to see improvement, but the stats say it would be a minor miracle if this series gets to 6 games.

**Prediction:  Sumter in 4**

messages.author: Ticklepuss
messages.text:
__(2) Pitt vs (15) Highland__
The latest version of the Ballerina Bowl is set to kick off the Brule this season, with both teams expected to be in their leotards and on the ice by 8:30 tonight.

What to Expect:  
The history between these two best online friends is well documented.  They are cross-state rivals, wrapped in a mysterious cloak of exis.  Just how much they play these practice games is anyone’s guess.  Estimates range from 15 - 60 a week.  A few leaks have come out over the years, such as the fact that one of them refuses to turn off penalties citing World National settings dedication.  Nonetheless, these 2 have met a few times in the playoffs with Pitt having the upper hand.  The Intramurals had another amazing regular season, keeping the #1 seed in their sights up until the final day of the regular season.  Still, of all 1st round draws, getting matched up with the team you play the most doesn’t seem ideal.  Unless, of course, Pitt wins most of those games.  Highland’s best shot to advance likely needs to be a full series of lockdown drag-out camping pussy.  That’s all we got for this one….

** Prediction:  Pitt in 6**

messages.author: Ticklepuss
messages.text:
__(4) Thunder Bay vs (13) Easter Island__
This matchup could be the jewel of the 1st round, or it might not.  Easter Isle returns to the W and warms to the task right out of the gate with a lesser roster, while Thunder Bay looks to repeat for about the 8th time.

What to Expect:  
Stylistically, this should be a treat to watch.  Both are great in every area - F, D, G, and each can shapeshift styles on the fly.  This is probably the worst of all the possible matchups Thunder Bay could have gotten in the 1st round across the bottom 8.  That’s not to say the Pike won’t be confident.  They have the better roster and more recent 7 game series experience.  Coach Big Belly is well aware that he could lose this series, so he will be ready.  Coach LHX probably also thinks he can win if he plays perfectly, which is to say, Thunder Bay is still the obvious favorite despite this potential landmine.  Thunder Bay has never failed to get past the 1st round.  LHX has beaten Shawn multiple times in other tier 2 leagues (we think and heard on a top 10 podcast), giving this all the makings of a potential all-timer…..Or not….


** Prediction:  Thunder Bay in 6**

messages.author: Ticklepuss
messages.text:
__(5) Providence vs (12) Tegucigalpa
__These two dear friends, fresh off their regular season finale together, get to do it all over again now.  It seems these 2 teams have played in the Brule relatively recently, but according to a popular NHL95 website, it’s been 5 years already since Tegucigalpa sent Providence back to the beauty parlor in 7 games.

What to Expect:  
Party “Dan”, somewhat quietly and without much fanfare, has his highest seed in a very long time.  How long?  We aren’t sure and didn’t care to look.  These 2 squads typically play a fun end-to-end style that could be different than the rest of the 1st round matchups.  It wouldn’t be surprising if this series has the highest scoring R1 series….so if you like offense, tune in sometime in the future.  The standard playbook between these two are a high-flying 1 timing squiring team, backstopped by a camping pussy, versus a team that likes to skate, sucks at camping, and uses the C button to score.  Many times the victor here is which team does better on breakaways.  Over 7 games, there will be other factors, such as: how many squirts sneak through, can Tegucigalpa actually stop a one-timer they know is coming, can Providence shapeshift for once?


** Prediction:  Providence in 4**

messages.author: Ticklepuss
messages.text:
__(6) Woodlynne vs (11) Grand River__
Like Easter Isle, Coach Moses returned to the W after a long hiatus and put together a very impressive campaign.  The Herons started the season as a long(ish) shot to get into the top 16, so #11 is an accomplishment in its own right.  Woodlynne is back in the tournament again, and again a team nobody wants to see themselves paired up with.

What to Expect:  
Recently, some podcasters picked the Herons to advance in this series.  We found it quite surprising, but they do know Moses best.  From here, we just don’t see it.  The Rats are brutally tough to play against.  Lock down D, great goaltending, and a steadily improving offense is a prime mixture for the playoffs.  The Rats seem destined to win one of these things one year, and it could happen at any time.  Grand River, as mentioned, did have a great season.  They also have the ability to lock things down in their own zone at times with solid tendy play.  If they get hot, they can go on a run no doubt….We still think Moses is the only team to eliminate KingRaph way back when.  This, however, feels like an awful matchup.  The creative ways that the Rats are able to generate just enough offense to win will really make things rough on Grand River.  


** Prediction:  Woodlynnne in 5**

messages.author: Ticklepuss
messages.text:
__(7) Maryhill vs (10) Minhattrick__
Win or lose, Maryhill is already the frontrunner for best car video of the year with their depiction of a petrified Nick from Minnesota running (unsuccessfully) from a bull.  Neither of these teams have missed the playoffs ever, so both know what they need to do.

What to Expect:  
This really is a great matchup on digital paper.  Somewhat of a mind bender.  It’s very easy to imagine Maryhill winning this quickly in 5 games.  It’s also easy to see them losing in 5 games.  Or both losing in 7 games.  A true clash of styles: male/female for starters, fast attacking offense/slow methodical, quiet and poised / constant moaning and belching.  They do have similarities in net though;  Nick from Minnesota is often named as a top manual goalie player, but Red has drastically improved in this area over the years.  The Swayzes are different in the playoffs than the regular season, but they are going against a team that is very familiar with how to get it done.  This one feels like it could go either way….We flipped a coin, and are picking the team that hits above the belt.


** Prediction:  Maryhill in 6**

messages.author: Ticklepuss
messages.text:
__(8) Betty Ford vs (9) Sugar Valley__
The 8/9 matchup is always a treat.  The Brule officially welcomes Betty Ford in their first legit shot at glory.  As is customary, you’ll be matched up with someone with a shitty connection and slippery when it comes to etiquette and morals.  Sugar Valley is officially at the contender hump.  

What to Expect:  
Hopefully this one goes off smooth, because it could be a dandy.  The leagues best lineup, guided by a rapidly improving rational Krav, should give the Firebirds all they can handle.  Sugar Valley as been drastically improving in their own right.  Once a team that seemingly just wanted to lead the league in shots on goal, has quietly improved their defensive play.  They may need to lean on that quite a bit in this series, because they can’t keep up with the guys Cardinal Krav sends over the boards.  Couple that with the fact that Betty Ford has lead the league in attack zone time for 3 straight seasons (we think?), and it’s easy to see how the Clinic could outgun the Firebirds.  Coach Topher has some tricks - some of which aren’t effeminate - of his own.  Betty Ford might want a boat race, but Sugar Valley is wily enough to muck it up and piss in the pool.  This has all the makings of a fantastic series, and hopefully one that goes off without a technology hitch.



** Prediction:  Sugar Valley in 7**
